newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin gives speech to commemorate Ye Jianying, says leaders must carry on behest of Deng Xiaoping to promote reform and opening up policies
- President Jiang Zemin meets Belarus President Aleksandr Lukashenko, praises healthy ties
- Agricultral Bank extends 104 billion loans in year to end-March for purchase of grain, cotton and edible oil
- Premier Li Peng holds talks with Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong
CHINA SECURITIES
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
- Zhenhai builds China's biggest deepwater port, plans to raise capacity to 3.0 million tonnes from 1.0 million tonnes
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Central bank issues notice calling for improved bank management to prevent false money orders
- Analysis says yuan exchange rate expected to remain stable in short-term
- PICC Life insurance premium income up 102 percent in first quarter year-on-year
- China model steel maker Handan Iron and Steel makes 702 million yuan in profits in 1996
CHINA SECURITIES
- Hong Hu, vice minister of State Commission of Economic Restructuring says China drafting cooperative share-holding company law
- Economist Liu Guoguang says government should not relay on relaxing monetary policy to solve jobless problem
- Southwestern Chongqing city issues favourable policies to attract foreign investors
BEJING ECONOMIC DAILY
- State Bureau of Technical Supervision finds 64 percent of tea below standard
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Zhangjiagang customs earns 183 million yuan in first quarter
CHINA DAILY
- China's forests on high alert against forest fires
- CNTIC Trading Co issues 30 million shares, Minmetals Development Co to offer 75 million shares from Monday
- Health officials launch new drive to combat viral hepatitis
